ex-diabetes-en.comorbidities: Hypertension is current. Hyperlipidemia activity is unspecified. Nephropathy and neuropathy interpretation remain provisional; albuminuria and numbness are findings.
ex-diabetes-en.keyFindings: Reject poor diabetic control for denied hypoglycemia symptoms and eye surgery for ophthalmology review. Correct the later diabetes-relation anchor and date the negative retinopathy evidence.

ex-diabetes-es.comorbidities: Hipertensión arterial is current. Dislipemia activity unspecified. Nephropathy and peripheral diabetic neuropathy remain suspected.
ex-diabetes-es.keyFindings: Reject profuse pigmented skin lesions, trabeculectomy revision, and hospital-specific podiatry. The urine ACR and class-level SGLT2 proposals are appropriate but still require mapping review.

ex-hf-en.expectedPrincipal: Acute decompensated HF on chronic HF with reduced EF
ex-hf-en.comorbidities: Current AF, CKD stage 3, hypertension. Admission symptoms/findings are not necessarily persistent at discharge.
ex-hf-en.keyFindings: Reject cardiomyopathy inferred from HFrEF, dyspnea for crackles, edema reduction for edema, pulmonary reflex for congestion, ST elevation for troponin, and urine ACR for renal blood tests.

ex-hf-es.expectedPrincipal: Insuficiencia cardíaca aguda descompensada sobre IC crónica con FE reducida
ex-hf-es.comorbidities: AF and hypertension are supported. CKD should retain stage 3 rather than generic CKD. Do not select 3a/3b without evidence.
ex-hf-es.keyFindings: Reject undocumented cardiomyopathy, chest-and-abdomen X-ray, 20 mg oral furosemide, ST elevation for troponin and urine ACR for renal blood testing. Preserve admission/discharge time scopes.

ex-full-report-en.comorbidities: AF, CAD, T2DM and CKD are current discharge diagnoses. Chronic systolic HF belongs to the acute-on-chronic problem. Essential hypertension appears only in PMH. Review IHD/CAD duplication.
ex-full-report-en.keyFindings: No gross unrelated top mapping, but acute HF remains too broad for automatic acceptance. Completed PCI and aspirin are supported. Family MI/breast cancer remain separate.

ex-oncology-en.expectedPrincipal: Confirmed invasive ductal carcinoma of the left breast
ex-oncology-en.comorbidities: No other confirmed active disease is documented. Postoperative pain and receptor/margin/node results are findings; maternal breast cancer is family history.
ex-oncology-en.keyFindings: Left infiltrating duct carcinoma is a suitable existing candidate. Reject metastatic-to-breast for negative node/general metastasis evidence, tramadol for analgesia, podiatry for tumor board, reconstruction for follow-up, and hormone replacement for endocrine-therapy discussion. Preserve completed breast surgery and discussion-only adjuvant plans.

ex-stroke-en.expectedPrincipal: Acute ischemic stroke, left MCA territory
ex-stroke-en.comorbidities: Paroxysmal AF is current; embolic attribution is likely rather than confirmed. Hypertension/hyperlipidemia appear in PMH with continued therapy as further evidence for review. Aphasia/weakness are findings.
ex-stroke-en.keyFindings: Reject small-artery stroke subtype, coronary thrombolysis, dabigatran/combination antihypertensive drugs, functional MRI and edema reduction. Safer ischemic-stroke and cerebral-thrombolysis candidates are already projected.

ex-chestpain-en.expectedPrincipal: Presenting chest-pain episode; pain resolved before arrival
ex-chestpain-en.comorbidities: Hypertension and T2DM are background with activity unspecified. Angina and MI remain unconfirmed. Father’s MI is family history.
ex-chestpain-en.keyFindings: Separate encounter diagnosis from physical current-pain denial. Troponin and admission must not map to device monitoring. ECG, plain chest X-ray, aspirin and statin proposals are supported.

ex-chestpain-es.expectedPrincipal: Episodio de dolor torácico; dolor actual resuelto
ex-chestpain-es.comorbidities: Background hypertension and T2DM, current activity unspecified. Angina and MI unconfirmed; paternal MI is family history.
ex-chestpain-es.keyFindings: Reject normal heart sounds under a murmur-negation assertion, heart sounds for lung auscultation, anterolateral territory for generic ST change, abdominal X-ray and reinsertion surgery for admission.

gold-en-diabetes.expectedPrincipal: Diabetic nephropathy as the main assessment diagnosis
gold-en-diabetes.comorbidities: T2DM is a current background condition. Retinopathy negative on current review; maternal T2DM is family history.
gold-en-diabetes.keyFindings: Five base proposals are supported. Repeat urine albumin must not acquire a creatinine ratio. The gold label for continue metformin should represent continuation, and the source reference omits the repeat laboratory plan.

gold-es-diabetes.expectedPrincipal: T2DM stated under Motivo; nephropathy confirmed in evaluation
gold-es-diabetes.comorbidities: Both T2DM and nephropathy are confirmed. The source does not unambiguously justify the benchmark's nephropathy principal over its stated T2DM encounter context.
gold-es-diabetes.keyFindings: Do not force the English gold principal onto a differently worded Spanish note. Continue metformin is continuation; urinary albumin is not necessarily an ACR test.

gold-en-oncology.comorbidities: No active comorbidities. Metastatic carcinoma is absent by the stated evidence.
gold-en-oncology.keyFindings: All three top proposals add unsupported specificity or change the action: primary carcinoma, metastasis to breast and podiatry referral. General carcinoma-of-breast is already an alternative. Gold facts omit the tumor-board plan.

gold-en-cardiology.comorbidities: HF is a current complication. AF history has unspecified activity. Current chest pain is denied.
gold-en-cardiology.keyFindings: All four returned base mappings and assertions are supported. Preserve the documented MI-to-HF complication relation. The benchmark MI fact uses a broader code/phrase than its acute principal, so hierarchy-only scores require care.

gold-en-cardio-renal.comorbidities: Hypertension on treatment is current. Known CKD activity needs adjudication. Pneumonia remains suspected pending imaging.
gold-en-cardio-renal.keyFindings: The principal is incorrectly dyspnea while the confirmed acute HF mapping remains under review. Admission for monitoring is incorrectly a device-assessment procedure. The gold chronic-decompensated-HF code should not acquire chronicity solely from 'known HF'.

gold-en-ischemic.comorbidities: Stable angina and T2DM are in history; active comorbidity status needs source-context review. Paternal MI is family history.
gold-en-ischemic.keyFindings: Diagnostic coronary angiography retrieves angioplasty/PCI, an unacceptable procedure substitution. Future aspirin and atorvastatin starts are supported without strength/combination inference.

gold-en-respiratory.comorbidities: Cough/wheeze are symptoms; COPD background links to the exacerbation. Former smoking is social history. No examination signs of pneumonia is limited negative evidence.
gold-en-respiratory.keyFindings: Principal productive cough is wrong despite an accepted COPD-exacerbation mapping. Wheeze maps to dyspnea; nebulized salbutamol maps to a dry-powder dose and prednisolone to an unspecified concentration. Beta-2 antagonists are unsuitable salbutamol alternatives.
